class.name: IfcWallStandardCase
class.brief_description: The IfcWallStandardCase defines a wall with certain constraints for the provision of parameters and with certain constraints for the geometric representation. The IfcWallStandardCase handles all cases of walls, that are extruded vertically: along the positive z axis of the wall object coordinate system, and along the positve z axis of the global (world) coordinate system and have a single thicknes
